lines: Chaand bhi dekha, phool bhi dekha, baadal, bijli, titli, jugnu
Koi nahin hai aisa, tera husn hai jaisa, tera husn hai jaisa
couplets.en: I have seen the moon, the flower, clouds, lightning, butterflies and fireflies, and still your beauty has no equal.

lines: Meri nigaah ne yeh kaisa khwaab dekha hai
Zameen pe chalta hua mahtaab dekha hai
couplets.en: What dream did my eyes behold, a moon walking on the earth?

lines: Meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
Meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
couplets.en: Having seen the world, my eyes chose you.

lines: Kiska chehra, kiska chehra ab main dekhoon tera chehra dekh kar
Meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
couplets.en: Having seen the world and chosen you, whose face could my eyes turn to now?

lines: Neend bhi dekhi, khwaab bhi dekha, neend bhi dekhi, khwaab bhi dekha
Choodi, bindiya, darpan, khushboo, koi nahin hai aisa
couplets.en: I have known sleep and dreams, the bangle, the bindi, the mirror and its lingering fragrance, and found nothing to compare.

lines: Tera pyaar hai jaisa
Tera pyaar hai jaisa
Meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
Meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
couplets.en: Having seen the world, my eyes chose you.

lines: Kiska chehra, kiska chehra ab main dekhoon tera chehra dekh kar
Meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
couplets.en: Having seen the world and chosen you, whose face could my eyes turn to now?

lines: Rang bhi dekha, roop bhi dekha, rang bhi dekha, roop bhi dekha
Rasta, manzil, saahil, mehfil
couplets.en: I have seen colour and beauty, the road and its end, the shore and the gathering.

lines: Rang bhi dekha, roop bhi dekha, saahil, mehfil, koi nahin hai aisa
Tera saath hai jaisa, ho, tera saath hai jaisa
couplets.en: Of all the beauty I have seen, nothing compares to being with you.

lines: Meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
Meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
couplets.en: Having seen the world, my eyes chose you.

lines: Kiska chehra, kiska chehra ab main dekhoon tera chehra dekh kar
Meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
couplets.en: Having seen the world and chosen you, whose face could my eyes turn to now?

lines: Bahut khoobsurat hain aankhen tumhari
Bana dijiye inko qismat hamari
couplets.en: Let those beautiful eyes of yours be my fate.

lines: Use aur kya chahiye zindagi mein
Jise mil gayi hai mohabbat tumhari
couplets.en: What more could life offer someone who has found your love?

lines: Kitna pyaar tumhein karte hain
Aaj hamein maaloom hua
couplets.en: Only today did I learn how much I love you.

lines: Bahut khoobsurat ghazal likh raha hoon, bahut khoobsurat ghazal likh raha hoon
Tumhein dekh kar aaj kal likh raha hoon
couplets.en: These days I look at you and find myself writing a beautiful ghazal.
